status: EXPLORATORY pilot of docs/13 amendment A4, hypothesis H9.7 (transformer frontier), and the input of gate G1 frame. Seeds of 100 or more (docs/13 A4 'Seeds'): never reported as confirmatory. Validation split only; the test split is never loaded. Learning rate chosen on validation at the 150 s cap, as H9.7 allows. Every job runs alone on the GPU under scripts/gpu_run.sh exclusive, one job at a time.
docs: docs/13 amendment A4 (H9.7, gate G1 frame); src/tmlm/eval/baselines/transformer_small.py (model, data packing, evaluation, NVML sampler, learning-rate schedule)

model.class: tmlm.eval.baselines.transformer_small.SmallTransformer (pre-LN, learned positions, tied head, GELU MLP 4d, same-document causal mask), unchanged
model.heads_rule: head dimension 64 (width / 64), as the M2 L6 W256 model (4 heads)

training.precision: fp16 autocast (torch.autocast('cuda', dtype=torch.float16)) with torch.amp.GradScaler (default init scale 65536), fp32 master weights; loss in fp32
training.batch_note: 16 windows of 1024 = 16,384 positions per step, the same number of positions per step as the M2 transformer (64 x 256); not tuned
training.optimizer: AdamW, betas (0.9, 0.95), weight decay 0.01, gradient clipping at 1.0 after unscaling (as transformer_small.train)
training.schedule: transformer_small.lr_at: linear warmup over 200 steps, then linear decay driven by the elapsed fraction of the wall-clock cap to 0.1 x peak
training.data: random windows of 1024 of the packed train stream (BOS before every document), shuffled epochs, numpy default_rng(seed) (as transformer_small.train)
training.determinism: transformer_small.seed_everything(seed) before every model is built; torch deterministic algorithms with warn_only (memory-efficient attention stays non-deterministic on the V100, logged)

lr_selection.metric: validation bits per byte (protocol CP, transformer_small.bits_per_byte, seq_len 1024, stride 512, fp32 evaluation)
lr_selection.rule: per family, the grid value with the lowest validation bits per byte at the 150 s cap; ties to the smaller learning rate; the rule is applied in code by the 600 s run (--select-from)
lr_selection.name: cvtm_H9_7_tuned_lrsel_exploratory

cap_600.rule: every family at its selected learning rate, seed 100
cap_600.name: cvtm_H9_7_tuned_600s_exploratory

energy: transformer_small.NvmlPowerSampler (10 Hz, device-wide) over every training loop; idle 10 s after the CUDA context exists, once per process; joules raw and idle-subtracted; a 10 s idle sample after every training is logged as a diagnostic and not used

gate_G1_frame.input: the lowest validation bits per byte among the tuned families at the 600 s cap
gate_G1_frame.rule: input <= 1.2209: the LM result is framed only as the energy frontier E*(D) plus the white-box properties, no parity sentence; input > 1.2209: a parity sentence is allowed against the TUNED 600 s comparator only

h9_7_prediction_checked: the tuned 600 s model beats 1.2409 (the CVTM-core; docs/13 A4 prediction 0.6); reported, no threshold

launch.lrsel: scripts/gpu_run.sh exclusive -- scripts/cpu_slot.sh 1 -- .venv-tm/bin/python scripts/mem_guard.py -- scripts/run_logged.py --name cvtm_H9_7_tuned_lrsel_exploratory --config experiments/cvtm/configs/H9_7_tuned_pilot.json -- .venv-dl/bin/python -u experiments/cvtm_transformer_tuned.py --mode tuned_lrsel --config experiments/cvtm/configs/H9_7_tuned_pilot.json
launch.cap600: scripts/gpu_run.sh exclusive -- scripts/cpu_slot.sh 1 -- .venv-tm/bin/python scripts/mem_guard.py -- scripts/run_logged.py --name cvtm_H9_7_tuned_600s_exploratory --config experiments/cvtm/configs/H9_7_tuned_pilot.json -- .venv-dl/bin/python -u experiments/cvtm_transformer_tuned.py --mode tuned_cap --time-cap-s 600 --config experiments/cvtm/configs/H9_7_tuned_pilot.json --select-from results/<lrsel run>

not_run_now: the frontier caps 2400 s and 9600 s, the L6 W256 and L12 W768 members of the H9.7 family, confirmatory seeds, and the CVTM-core fit joules at the H8.8 prefixes (E*(D)); their commands are listed in experiments/cvtm_transformer_tuned.py (docstring, 'Later')
